headline_marked: [[JCD forms probe body]] after attack on journalists, students at RU injures 10
headline: JCD forms probe body after attack on journalists, students at RU injures 10
summary: At least 10 people, including four journalists, were injured in an alleged attack by JCD activists at Rajshahi University. The student wing has formed a committee to investigate the incident.
details: Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal (JCD) has formed a two-member committee to investigate an alleged attack at Rajshahi University that left at least 10 people, including students and journalists, injured on Sunday night.
The committee, headed by JCD central vice-presidents ABM Ijazul Kabir Ruel and Manjurul Alam Riad, has been tasked with submitting a written report within 24 hours, according to a press release.

The incident occurred around 8:30pm in front of Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Hall, where witnesses alleged a group of RU JCD leaders and activists attacked journalists and students. Several members of the group were reportedly carrying machetes, hockey sticks, pipes, and baseball bats.

Among those injured were journalists Nur Ahsan Mridul (The Daily Star and RU Reporters Unity President), Zahidul Islam (Agamir Shomoy), Arifuzzaman Korban (bdnews24.com), and Mainul Islam Raju (Samakal). RU JCD leaders were identified by witnesses as being involved.
The National Citizen Party has condemned the alleged attack, demanding the arrest and punishment of those responsible.

headline_marked: Pritom Hasan and Shahtaj Monira [[announce the end of their marriage]]
headline: Pritom Hasan and Shahtaj Monira announce the end of their marriage
summary: The musician and actor duo, together for nearly 10 years, cited significant differences in mutual understanding as the reason for their separation.
details: Musician and actor Pritom Hasan and model, actor and singer Shahtaj Monira Hashem have decided to end their marriage. The couple announced the decision in separate Facebook posts on Sunday night, citing significant differences in their mutual understanding.

Pritom shared that the decision was not made suddenly but followed extensive thought and discussions between them and with the support and consent of their families. They are currently undergoing the process of divorce.

Shahtaj shared a similar statement, confirming that they have decided to end their marital relationship amicably. Both expressed gratitude for the time, memories, and experiences they shared over the last decade.

The couple first met in 2017 while working on the music video for Pritom's popular song "Jadukor", where Shahtaj appeared as a model. Their professional relationship later developed into a romantic one.

After being together for several years, they married on October 29, 2022, in Sreemangal. They frequently shared moments of their life together on social media, and were seen together as recently as January this year.
Both Pritom and Shahtaj have requested respect for their privacy and personal space during this transition, asking friends, colleagues, and the media to approach the matter with empathy.
